notes.title: Alpha 0.1.19: quick patch for a few bugs
notes.content:
Our intrepid bug reporters have brought our attention to a few ickies that needed to be squashed. Thank you folks!

[list]
    [*]Door opening in analyzer tanks too small for some foods -- now enlarged
    [*]Bug reporter wasn't giving back keyboard control after window closed -- OOOF! fixed
    [*]Missing tank and misaligned nose cone in intro animation -- fixed
    [*]Some part names in "Here are some parts" intro scene incorrectly named
[/list]

Thanks again for pointing these out -- now back to cranking out rocket parts and planets!

notes.title: New Rocket Parts, Mission Generator in 0.1.17
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/bff5ece3b7f82c76264853446793be7611e8c856.png[/img]
Last night's update to 0.1.17 brings three new rocket parts to play with:
[list]
    [*]The Blaaat! Booster, more powerful than the Mama booster, but carbs-restricted.
    [*]The flying Carbo-analyzer, an instrument you can load with food and fly to research carbohydrate, sugar and fiber food properties.
    [*]The flying Elemental Spectrometer, an instrument you can load with food to research elements contained in food, such as Sodium, Potassium & Iron.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/ba3061b0ca8f020fe78353074ef18ed5f6baa179.png[/img]
Under the hood, we've completely revamped and upgraded the mission generation system. The missions now have a greater variety both in type and the rewards for successful completion. Be sure to check the mission description for full details of what to do. Importantly, most missions now expire after some minutes, so always check the mission board before equipping your rocket with parts and food!

The flying Elemental Spectrometer, an instrument you can load with food to research elements contained in food, such as Sodium, Potassium & Iron.
Under the hood, we've completely revamped and upgraded the mission generation system.
The missions now have a greater variety both in type and the rewards for successful completion.

The flying Carbo-analyzer, an instrument you can load with food and fly to research carbohydrate, sugar and fiber food properties.
The flying Elemental Spectrometer, an instrument you can load with food to research elements contained in food, such as Sodium, Potassium & Iron.
Under the hood, we've completely revamped and upgraded the mission generation system.
The missions now have a greater variety both in type and the rewards for successful completion.

notes.title: Hotfix patch uploaded for 0.1.16
notes.content:
We've uploaded a patch that addresses a couple of issues posted out by you, the teeming millions in the last 24 hours.

-- It was possible to run out of food on Krunchon -- if enough fell into the drink, eventually leaving you stranded.
-- The button on the title screen for the tutorial has been removed. We've changed so many things with the main game loop that the existing tutorial made no sense. We'll circle back to that ASAP.


While a "Load" button now appears on the main screen, it currently does nothing. We're very busy overhauling that bit of code. We expect that to be fixed with the next update.

Thanks as always for your support!

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.6 Hotfix for broken Hangar now up
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/af52034a791597f12e01828c71ae964a61aa8b5a.png[/img]

The last update inadvertently made it impossible to save a rocket; 0.1.6 fixes that and does away with the previous save scheme. Now instead of saving whole rockets, you save designs, which can be applied to the current rocket at will, as long as you can afford the parts! We think this is a lot more intuiative and far less confusing (I suppose that is a tautology, but whatever...)

3 Days to go!

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.4 Available to testers
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30938049/7c5b3cc181c3fd3ff5e49d61ee59672726f839bf.png[/img]

Today's Alpha release features a streamlined parts purchasing system; gone is the shop and parts inventory. Instead parts are purchased directly in the hangar. Cost is deducted from your savings when the part is placed on the blueprint. Deleted parts earn refunds.


Also in this update -- constraints have been removed from the field; you can fly as far to the left and right as you like. And the Hangar and Mission Control are now represented on the field, and you can travel to them when you hover nearby.


Change log:

Alpha 0.1.4
Additions:
Hangar on Field
Mission Control Building on Field
Steam Achievements implemented

Changes:
Removed double logo on start
Removed left and right constraints
Hangar and Mission Control triggers are no longer modal
Streamlined rocket part purchasing system: parts are purchased in the hangar as they are placed; no longer a separate shop screen
Visual improvents in hangar UI
splat sprites on crash no longer extend beyond foreground
All new rocket part and copter art


Bug Fixes:
Mass wasn’t properly calculated on multi-stage rockets after jettison
No longer possible to fly off edges of world (blastoff)
settings return button fixed
